newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon lowers AT&T EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon lowers AT&T EPS view.

text.p: Salomon Bros analyst Jack Grubman on Monday cut his 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for AT&T Corp, while maintaining his "hold" rating on the stock.
Grubman said increasing competition in the telecommunications industry is the principal reason for the trimmed forecasts.
AT&T shares fell 2-1/4 to 39-1/4 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Here are excerpts from his AT&T research note:
-- the lower estimates are based on "what we believe will be significant spending on both core long-distance and new businesses."
